values.note: Primitive $14 a night (drive-in, listed for RVs, vehicle limits 30-70 ft; $14 weekends in June too, $16 at the top rate). Non-electric $20 (Thursday-Saturday $23). Electric $43-45 (Thursday-Saturday +$7). No out-of-state camping rate (the park entrance fee differs by plates). Booking site's prices for 2027 nights, read 2026-10-31.

summary: Base $20 -> $14 (drive-in primitive sites listed for RVs to 45+ ft); $20 and $43-45 confirmed. Water/sewer cleared (one site only). Added count, 91 ft, pull-through, dump, store. Note cleaned.
flags: BASE CALL: I took the $14 primitive sites as the base because ReserveAmerica calls them Drive-In, RV Site/Trailer Site, vehicle limit 30-70 ft. DNR's map shows them in a separate primitive campground. If you'd rather keep a non-electric base, it is $20 (Lakeview, 26-63 ft).
SEWER: site 193 in Whitetail is the single WATER/ELECTRIC/SEWER site (50A, 45 ft). Stored water/sewer true would make the whole campground pass a hookup filter.
WATER: lakeview stands. Lakeview loop's west pads are about 60 m from the shore through trees on imagery; no apron; Hide-A-Way's end is similar. No site reads as on the water.
PHONE: 765-344-1412 per DNR page; stored phone is empty. Alert: yellow blue-green algae advisory at the beach, swimming and boating permitted.
note: Indiana DNR, Raccoon SRA on Cecil M. Harden Lake (Mansfield Reservoir). Many sites need leveling. The 'Lakeview' loop faces the lake (partly tree-screened views, steep access) but no sites are at the water's edge. --Claude
